title: Permission onboarding
idea: Permission onboarding: Explain one capability at its moment of use with a skip path
audience: People who need to grant permission within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: A feature genuinely requires device access
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its grant permission priority and explicit commitment contract: Never make consent look preselected
navigation: Permission onboarding keeps the current grant permission context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Explain one capability at its moment of use with a skip path
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to grant permission; a feature genuinely requires device access

imagery.role: Support the actual grant permission context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep system prompt recovery and denial alternatives visible
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the permission onboarding structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no grant permission content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Never make consent look preselected
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized grant permission content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active grant permission context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
